identity: An unopened future letter arrives at a contemporary desk; its shadow links administrative counters, a laboratory metric and consumed personal time; human figures pause before stamping acceptance, without depicting final verdicts.
typography: One shared Red Hat Display scene title; meaningful object labels in Red Hat Display at 32px or larger; Red Hat Text captions, one full sentence at a time.
composition: Four bespoke scene arrangements per book; scale changes, pair comparison, spatial separation and meaningful object movement. No duplicate slogans, decorative outlines or irrelevant connecting lines.
themes: Flat Color, Light and Dark backgrounds, with explicit dark contrast for original palette fills and text.
motion: Reveal on narrative cue; 1.5 second breathing holds, longer scene conclusions, no autoplay audio testing.
